xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
The supplied C4 shapes and role colors are used. Person2 =
internal/external person; rounded blocks = System, Container or
Component as labeled; cylinder3 = Data Container; horizontal
cylinder3 = Message Bus; hexagon = Microservice Container; C4
browser = browser container. Gray dashed rounded frames =
System/Container logical scope, with bottom captions. Text
contrast and dimensions are adapted for readability. Empty scopes
are notation samples.
